purpose: Exploratory A/B comparison of source-target-only review versus the same pairs with fixed public-source context after the formal GLM truth-set gate returned NO_GO.

sample.selection: All eligible determinate defects; four named context-exonerated clean disputes; then two ordinary CLEAN controls per Runtime/Narrative category by frozen SHA-256 ranking with task uniqueness inside the ordinary pool.
sample.presentation: All selected rows ranked by frozen SHA-256 presentation seed and relabeled E001-E014. A and B use identical order/source/target; only fixed_context differs.

arms.A: source + target; fixed_context is an empty array
arms.B: identical source + target + sanitized raw fixed public-source excerpts with [SOURCE_MATCH] marker

routes.identity_limitation: retained CLI envelope may not independently attest runtime model identity

routes.qualification: formal purity NO-GO; exploratory participation explicitly allowed
formal truth-set gate NO-GO; exact provider/model required for exploratory validity

routes.identity_limitation: historical Antigravity envelopes omit runtime model identity

availability_checked.codex: local version command; route availability will be established by acquisition
availability_checked.claude: local version command; route availability will be established by acquisition

validity.response: Each candidate must parse, contain exactly 14 E001-E014 items once in order, and satisfy the frozen output fields/enums.
validity.route_identity: Recorded separately from response validity. Exact Pi mismatch invalidates the candidate; unverified Codex/Gemini provenance and unqualified Claude are retained only as explicit exploratory limitations.
validity.raw_reuse: Acquisition RAW and its hashes are immutable. Parser-only repair uses --parse-existing and must not make a new model call.
validity.reference_sealed: REFERENCE.json and all truth labels/atoms are local scorer inputs only and are never concatenated into model prompts.

preregistered_analysis.atom_hit: A defect hit requires FINDING plus identification of the sealed material atom; generic criticism or a different issue is not a hit.
preregistered_analysis.clean_false_positive: Any FINDING on either clean class is a false positive; UNCERTAIN is reported separately.
paired_outputs: context-defect atom delta B minus A for each repeat
surface-defect atom retention B minus A
context-exonerated clean false-positive delta B minus A
all-clean false-positive delta B minus A
prohibited_claims: general context-defect recall from the single context case
population specificity from deliberately easy ordinary clean controls

authorization.basis: The user permanently authorized this project to send sanitized experimental records to OpenAI, Anthropic, Z.ai CN/GLM and Google Gemini.
